question: For which discovery did William Bradford Shockley, John Bardeen and Walter Houser Brattain jointly receive the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1956?

options.text: Discovery of receptors for temperature and touch

solution:
The correct answer is __**Discovery of transistor effect.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **In 1956,** **William Bradford Shockley, John Bardeen, and Walter Houser Brattain jointly received the Nobel Prize in Physics **for their **research on semiconductors and their discovery of the transistor effect.**
